notes: The acquisition pipeline stops being a permanent fixture. It is now a settings switch: off by default, and while it is off the left-nav entry is simply not there - turn it on in Settings and the entry appears; a direct link still lands, and only a visible-to-hidden change walks you off the view. The switch and the view's own control write the same key, so they cannot disagree. Worth saying plainly: the pipeline's MECHANISM is proven - the six stages, the send gate, your approval queue and a local SMTP round trip - but the model drafting brain is a deliberately unwired seam (the body is a template you edit today) and a real provider send still waits for credentials. So it is a review-and-approve surface, not a self-running acquisition machine, and now it stays out of your way until you ask for it. Second: on the skills shelf the category label used to sit in the card corner and a long skill name ran under it; the label is now its own line above the name, so the two cannot overlap at any width - measured after the fix: 38 cards, zero overlaps. No new credential, no new outbound path.
